days.title: Hanseatic City and Island Heritage
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Visby
stops.detail: The main settlement and only city on the island is the former Hanseatic city of Visby.

stops.name: Gotlands Fornsal
stops.detail: The Bunge open-air museum and Gotlands Fornsal in Visby show a lot of it.

stops.name: Vallhagar
stops.detail: Cattle, goats, sheep, domestic pigs, and chickens are documented in the prehistoric settlement of Vallhagar.

days.title: Northern Lakes and Industrial History
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Bläse kalkbruksmuseum
stops.detail: In Bläse, there is a lime works museum (Swedish: Bläse kalkbruksmuseum).

stops.name: Bäste träsk
stops.detail: There are a total of about 50 lakes on Gotland that are constantly filled with water, four of which have an area of more than one square kilometer: Bäste träsk, Tingstädeträsk, Fardumeträsk, and Bogeviken.

stops.name: Tingstädeträsk
stops.detail: The Bulverket, a pile dwelling in Tingstädeträsk, is a unique structure from this era.
